speaker: alse_pinder
text: The steeples are all going. May I stand at the corner?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You may stand where I can see you. That is the whole of the permission.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am back. The guns were the Tower's, earlier. These are the parish.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I know a parish bell from a gun. Come up to the fire. You are late for a man who left before the broth.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is a real fire, sir. Not a furze-bush on a green.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is how you light a fire. For something.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For something. I see it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Did the horses run? Did anyone fall?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten pairs. I was too far down to count a fall. I am not telling it as a story.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not tell it. The girl may look. She may not have a plot of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am only looking. The sparks go higher than the sign.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Look, then. I have nothing to add to a spark.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have been on your feet since morning. You will not make a speech in my street. Warm your hands, and we are going in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: A little longer.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Until that log falls in. Then in. I allowed the door. I did not allow the night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Until the log. I am not arguing.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Was the Queen there?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A stillness behind glass. That is all I had of her. Do not ask me for more.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You heard him. Glass, and distance. The fire is the thing in front of you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The fire is better. I can feel it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Feel that. I am not bringing Whitehall into the close.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The log is down. In. Alse, your cloak was shut at church and it will be shut now.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am coming.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be up. I have a line to set down, and then I am done with the day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One candle. The fire out here is enough light for the parish.
